people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: Ephraim, he mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.
translations.bsb: Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is an unturned cake.
translations.kjv: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
translations.asv: Ephraim, he mixeth himself among the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
